routes.summary: Edit the skin's textures (colour, decals, logos, skin tone, full repaint) and repack them. No Unreal Editor needed.
commands: mrforge tex hue <texture> --shift 120   (or: tex tint / tex levels / tex overlay / tex replace, each with optional --mask)
mrforge tex sheet   then open build/preview/sheet.png and look at it
avoid: colour ops on _N normal maps (they encode direction, not colour)
editing a texture shared with another skin id without checking skin inspect

routes.summary: Change material instance parameters (tints, glow strength, roughness, rim colour) without touching textures.
avoid: changing texture parameters (swapping which texture a slot uses) - not supported in v0.1

routes.summary: New geometry: body shape, outfit edits. Export -> Blender -> Unreal 5.3.2 import/cook -> UAssetTool pack -> verify vs vanilla.
commands: mrforge doctor   (routes mesh-export and mesh-build must be available)
mrforge mesh blend   then edit work/mesh/*.blend in Blender (keep bones, weights, material slots)
mrforge mesh inflate --bone <bone> --factor 1.2   (optional scripted body-shape edit)
mrforge mesh preview   then look at build/preview/<mesh>.png
mrforge build   (cooks only edited meshes; mesh build cooks all)
avoid: packing the Skeleton or PhysicsAsset placeholders

routes.summary: Jiggle, hair, cloth and tail physics: add KawaiiPhysics chains or tune existing ones in matches (no editor), and spring-bone jiggle in the lobby / hero select (built headless in Unreal 5.3.2).
commands: mrforge doctor   (routes physics, and physics-lobby for hero-select springs)
mrforge phys list   (nodes, chains, root bones, parameters)
mrforge phys add-chain --root L_Breast_01_Jnt --root R_Breast_01_Jnt --preset jiggle   (in matches)
mrforge phys springs --region chest --region butt --region thighs   (lobby; or --bone <name>)
mrforge phys set Damping 0.25 --bone "*hair*"   (tune existing chains)
avoid: guessing bone names (check them in Blender after mesh export/blend)
chains and springs on the same asset (one route per asset)

routes.summary: Audio, voice lines, UI, maps and gameplay changes are outside this forge (skin mods only).
commands: none: this forge makes skin mods only
